title: Tensor comparison summand formulas
statement:
theorem section_tensor_total_summand
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    [∀ X : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleRingedComparison.modules Λ X)]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ Z) ℤ)
    (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    (ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ Z).functor.map
        (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj P Q p q n hpq) ≫
      (ModuleRingedComparison.totalComparison Λ Z P Q).hom.f n =
    (ModuleRingedComparison.ordinaryTensorComparison Λ Z (P.X p) (Q.X q)).hom ≫
      HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj
        (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ Z).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ Z).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4; scalar and total tensor comparisons in the proof of pullback compatibility.

proof.text: The defining existence-and-uniqueness theorem for totalComparison prescribes its value on every tensor summand. Apply its chosen witness specification. The private categorical pasting and termwise tensor naturality helpers use associativity, functor naturality, and GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorHom. A private scalar-total summand formula applies mapBifunctorComparison to the normalized ordinary scalar tensor map, so totalScalar stays folded in the parent calculation.
